description: This repository documents a spatial urban-cooling analysis for the Lausanne agglomeration in Switzerland. Its README provides a Makefile workflow, environment instructions, linked input-data repositories and the related Geoscientific Model Development paper. The study uses the InVEST urban cooling model with land cover, building cover, reference evapotranspiration and monitoring-station temperatures to simulate spatial variation in heat mitigation. Outputs are reproducible maps, tables and figures for the Lausanne region. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the workflow; linked Zenodo inputs have their own terms. A limitation is that reported modelled cooling depends on the selected reference dates, local calibration and land-cover assumptions, and G7 did not reproduce the figures. The case can inform green-space and public-space adaptation scenarios while showing the exact preparation steps used for one city. The catalogue's QGIS platform can work with the mapped outputs, but it is not the InVEST model used here. No data file or computational environment was downloaded.
name: Lausanne InVEST urban cooling application
notes: G7 G7-1987. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
outcomes: Published spatially explicit urban cooling maps, tables and figures; no implemented mitigation outcome is claimed.
